purpose: Define stable project sense identities and bounded source-evidence mapping for an English VPC/VID benchmark without treating dictionary lookup as contextual gold.

core_tasks: confirmed occurrence to candidate-sense inventory alignment
excluded_claims: dictionary membership proves an occurrence is an MWE
an exact lookup miss proves lexical or semantic absence
a dictionary gloss is contextual gold
a source sense identifier is the project's primary identifier
a source fingerprint is a semantic identifier
one inventory is a universal English sense taxonomy

project_identity.allocation: Assign the next unused opaque integer in a versioned registry; IDs contain no lemma, category, source, or gloss semantics.
rules: Every admitted type receives one project type ID, including types aligned exactly to OEWN.
Every admitted sense receives one project sense ID; source IDs remain links, never primary keys.
An allocated ID is never reassigned, recycled, or silently redirected.
A spelling, display-lemma, or category correction that preserves identity keeps the ID and is logged.
A changed meaning boundary creates a new sense ID under the lifecycle rules.

definition_shape.rule: Source wording must remain in a separately licensed layer; a project-original definition must not be a cosmetic paraphrase used to evade upstream terms.

rules: Inflection and intervening non-member gaps do not create a new lexical type.
A pronoun in take it in is an occurrence-level non-member gap unless the frozen type record says it is a lexicalized member.
A fixed article or possessive may remain a lexical member even when the bounded source-mapping prefilter removes it to propose a candidate.
A structurally different variant shares a type ID only after independently verified construction and meaning equivalence.

source_link_rules: source_sense_id may be null only when the source supplies no stable sense identifier
a null source_sense_id requires a source_record_sha256 and does not weaken the project ID requirement
candidate_only is evidence for review and cannot by itself create gold
broader, narrower, and overlapping links remain explicit and cannot be exported as equivalence
every source artifact and source record fingerprint is verified before an inventory release is frozen
state_invariants: source_anchored requires every active project sense to have an independently_verified equivalent source link
hybrid requires at least one source-anchored and at least one project-defined active sense
project_defined requires at least one active project sense and no claim that every sense has a source equivalent
unresolved has no admitted project senses and remains in population-level coverage denominators
all_active_senses_verified is valid only for source_anchored; partly_verified is required for hybrid
candidate_route_only and no_bounded_route never imply an admitted source equivalence
observed_vmwe_categories is a non-empty array and never forces one category onto every occurrence or sense of a canonical form
a sense ID starts with its type ID followed by '-s'
a sense-level rights record and every source link use only declared license identifiers from the release manifest

fingerprints.artifact_rule: Hash the exact downloaded artifact bytes before extraction.
fingerprints.source_record_rule: Hash UTF-8 JSON of the declared source-record projection with object keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', ensure_ascii false, and no trailing newline.
fingerprints.warning: Fingerprints detect source-record change; they do not assert meaning identity or replace project sense IDs.

enwiktionary: dated English Wiktionary dump identity and SHA-256
page title and revision ID when present in the dump
pinned Wiktextract commit and extraction options
Wiktionary senseid when supplied, otherwise null
the chosen compliant reuse route, attribution/history record, and imported-content review

population.definition: All 239 STREUSLE V.VID types; the completed prefilter leaves a fixed residual of 146 types for the non-exact stages.

completed_prefilter.name: fixed_slot_skeleton
completed_prefilter.rule: Remove only a, an, the, my, your, his, her, its, our, their, one's, someone's, or somebody's from both lemmas, preserve all remaining token identities and order, and retain only a unique OEWN source-entry candidate.

remaining_ordered_stages.name: source_declared_variant_index
remaining_ordered_stages.rule: Build an index only from alternate-form and cross-reference fields explicitly encoded in the pinned OEWN and dated English Wiktionary verb records; match the unchanged target lemma to those declared fields.

remaining_ordered_stages.name: orthographic_equivalence
remaining_ordered_stages.rule: Build a second index over pinned source entry lemmas and declared variant strings using only declared Unicode, case, whitespace, hyphen, and apostrophe normalization; match the normalized target while preserving every open-class member and its order.

remaining_ordered_stages.name: logged_candidate_review
remaining_ordered_stages.rule: Review the complete candidate set produced by stages 4-5 without adding candidates; record equivalent, broader, narrower, overlapping, candidate_only, or no_bounded_route for every source link.

allowed_normalization: Unicode normalization declared by the source extractor
the already audited fixed closed-class slot deletion in prefilter stage 2
an inflection or alternate form explicitly linked by the pinned source
prohibited_operations: free Web or dictionary search after the bounded sources are exhausted
synonym, particle, preposition, or open-class word substitution not linked by a pinned source
using held-out occurrence context, gold labels, or baseline predictions to invent candidates
treating one plausible gloss as an accepted contextual label
excluding unresolved types from the benchmark population
creating a project-defined sense during this source-mapping pass
review_output_per_type: input canonical lemma and all observed categories
bounded_non_exact_mapping.stop_rule: Run remaining stages 4-6 once for every one of the 146 fixed residual types, without reprioritizing by familiarity, yield, or downstream performance. After stage 6, preserve no_bounded_route as unresolved. A project-defined sense inventory, if needed, is a separate lexicographic annotation phase whose guide, independent review, and rights decision are frozen before that phase begins.
bounded_non_exact_mapping.success_rule: This pass measures candidate-route coverage and mapping relations. It succeeds by exhausting the fixed population reproducibly, not by reaching a desired coverage percentage.

rules.assigned: Exactly one active project sense ID is selected.
rules.multiple_assigned: At least two distinct active project sense IDs genuinely apply together in context; preserve all of them.
rules.ambiguous: At least two named active project sense IDs remain alternative contextual readings that the evidence cannot resolve; preserve all of them.
rules.abstained: The annotator cannot make the declared judgment from the available evidence; do not force a sense or relabel it out_of_inventory.
rules.unassigned: The sense task has not been completed; this is workflow state, not a scored semantic outcome.
rules.out_of_inventory: The occurrence is confirmed, the frozen inventory was shown completely, the context supports a coherent meaning, and no active project sense is adequate. An exact dictionary miss alone never licenses this state.
rules.inventory_ineligible: The confirmed occurrence is outside the declared type or part-of-speech scope of the inventory. This is an administrative routing state, not a semantic absence claim.

contextual_assignment.separation_rule: Joint applicability, unresolved alternatives, insufficient evidence, type-level unresolved/no_bounded_route, occurrence-level out_of_inventory, and inventory ineligibility answer different questions and must never be collapsed.

inventory_release_versioning.patch: Correct non-semantic metadata, attribution, or formatting without changing IDs, forms, sense boundaries, mappings, or labels.
inventory_release_versioning.minor: Add new types or senses without changing any existing sense boundary or contextual label.
inventory_release_versioning.major: Change a sense boundary, mapping interpretation, or label meaning, including any merge or split.

lifecycle_and_versioning.split_rule: Deprecate the old sense ID, allocate at least two new sense IDs, and publish explicit split_from crosswalks; do not copy old occurrence labels forward automatically.
lifecycle_and_versioning.merge_rule: Deprecate every merged sense ID, allocate one new sense ID, and publish merged_from crosswalks; do not retain one old ID as if its meaning were unchanged.
lifecycle_and_versioning.deletion_rule: Deprecate rather than erase an allocated sense; state the reason and replacement IDs if any.
lifecycle_and_versioning.frozen_benchmark_rule: Any correction to a released benchmark creates a new version and manifest hash. Preserve the old release and report evaluation results against one exact version.

rules: Every released definition and source link declares one controlling_license_id, attribution notices, and redistribution status.
Project IDs and project decisions do not relicense source wording or imported content.
OEWN-derived wording remains under OEWN CC BY 4.0 plus the underlying WordNet notice.

Wiktionary-derived wording is released only after an exact dated artifact, compliant CC BY-SA 4.0 or GFDL route, attribution/history, ShareAlike where applicable, and imported-content review are recorded.
If source wording cannot be redistributed, release IDs, project-original annotations, permissible fingerprints, and reconstruction instructions while marking the wording external_only.
A private database or access control is not a rights grant.

inventory_builders_may_see: VMWE category evidence from non-held-out material
context_annotators_may_see: confirmed occurrence context required by the guide
the complete frozen active project sense inventory
independence_and_leakage.repair_rule: A held-out out_of_inventory decision cannot expand or backfit the same frozen test inventory. Log it as an error for a later release.

admission_gates: populate and independently review every target type under the bounded protocol
freeze a lawful public release route and layer-specific artifact manifest
freeze an annotation guide and training-only pilot before final labels
freeze document split, test seal, metrics, precision rule, and baselines
verify record invariants and exact release hashes
only then cut a new runtime contract version
